report.qualification: FastDyn/QEMU ARM BIL; shared generated offboard loop and plant; local-source commissioning run, not physical hardware latency

sensor_profile.distribution: 12-uniform sum approximation; assumed diagnostic magnitudes, not measured hardware
sensor_profile.hover_calibration_status: mean commanded PWM fraction over 30–35 s of closed-loop native Betaflight hover at 2 m in the shared plant
sensor_profile.motor_vibration: deterministic two-blade harmonic at 2*1100*normalized_motor rad/s; fixed per-motor and per-axis phase offsets; amplitude 0.25*IMU noise std scaled by motor command, assumed diagnostic model
sensor_profile.sensor_and_command_ingress: BF packets at 8000Hz hold 1600Hz IMU; CG reads latest at 1600Hz (up to 0.5ms stick-delivery quantization)

execution_notes: Patched OMNIBUSF4 ARM firmware; virtual IMU/receiver/motor/clock interfaces. Accelerometer quantization 2048 counts/g versus native SITL 256. No SPI/DMA latency or physical hardware measurements. Existing native hover-throttle calibration reused.
